An explicit pivot matching leaves a single ordinary critical 0-cell and nine critical 3-cells; all 600 ordinary Hasse faces pass an exhaustive acyclicity check. Forman discrete Morse theory yields the integral nine-sphere wedge without unspecified attaching degrees. All 48 automorphism signed Lefschetz characters independently coincide with the proposed rational signed-coordinate module, and rational semisimplicity identifies the group representation. The packaged verifier has been executed and exact output retained; finite exhaustivity is valid here because the claim is for one finite graph.

value.rationale: A canonical cubic bipartite cube is the smallest noncycle hypercube and a natural matching-deleted complete bipartite graph. The theorem proves a nontrivial saturated equality case in the 2026 top-homology edge-addition theory, an exact integral sphere-wedge homotopy type not covered by the complete-graph result, and a full 48-element rational homology symmetry module that no nonequivariant Betti number can determine. This is a natural complete classification of an intrinsically motivated finite graph complex rather than an arbitrary graph sample or numerical recomputation.
